static_traits.name: Fang Siping
static_traits.family_status: Has two children with his wife
static_traits.social_status: Supportive relationship with wife but tense due to fewer shared activities; has not yet confided current troubles to wife
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems in the past; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, peaceful tone, good logical thinking; positive attitude, but easily falls into negative automatic thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: Feels distressed because the most recent fishing trip failed to catch sunfish, and therefore believes he will never catch them again, producing hopelessness and disappointment.
basic_info.core_demands: These persistent negative thoughts are affecting my enjoyment of fishing; I hope through counseling to reduce these thoughts and regain the relaxation and pleasure fishing brings.

special_situations.event: The fishing trip two weeks ago failed to catch sunfish
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot catch sunfish this time, it means I have failed as a fisherman, and will never catch them in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pauses fishing, distracts attention through other activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never catch sunfish; I am a failure as a fisherman

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about or planning the next fishing trip
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once failed, it means failure will repeat in the future; continuing to plan is utterly meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cancelling or reducing fishing-related plans, avoiding related activities with one's wife
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will fail too,no hope

special_situations.event: High expectations for the last trip followed by disappointment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Fishing is either success or failure; as long as no sunfish is caught, it equals complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: To avoid disappointment again, reduces talking about or joining fishing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot catch any, it means I am completely incapable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be competent and gain relaxation and pleasure from fishing, while sharing the activity with his wife
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of failing again, afraid of disappointing himself and his partner
defense_goal: Avoids exposing failure and causing disappointment by retreating and reducing participation

object_relations.self_representation: Seeing himself as a failed fisherman of insufficient ability
object_relations.object_representation: The significant other (wife) is represented as a bystander or judge who may be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of fishing again, planning to fish, or when it involves activities once enjoyed with the wife (such as fishing)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting fishing results as 'all good or all bad'; once unsuccessful it equals being negated, and worrying the wife will be disappointed
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: A gentle but firm tone, avoiding binary judgments; use open-ended questioning to guide him to recall gray-area experiences (e.g., succeeding after changing spots or techniques), inviting him to describe present feelings and needs.

manifestations: The relaxation and enjoyment once gained from fishing drop greatly because of one failure
Expectations and sense of meaning around fishing eroded by the prophetic thought 'I will never catch any'
Shared activities with wife decrease, the relationship becomes strained

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Distracting oneself with other activities to avoid directly facing fishing-related disappointment and Anxiety
When thinking about fishing, quickly avoids specific plans and actions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-focuses on one failure and thereby limits subsequent contact and attempts

exception_events.target_problem: When thinking about or planning fishing, the client usually develops hopelessness and doubts his ability, then reduces or cancels fishing plans.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On some past days when fishing went poorly, he did not fall into the 'never succeeding' thought like this time, but tried changing spots or techniques, and eventually caught fish.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: actively adjusting strategy (changing spots, changing techniques); different understanding: viewing one poor outing as an improvable challenge rather than permanent failure.

positive_force: Was once able to solve difficulties by adjusting fishing spots and techniques and catch fish again
Work performance not yet affected; life structure relatively stable
Willing to seek help with a positive attitude
negative_force: Avoids communicating with wife, withdraws from shared activities
Highly sensitive to a single failure, prone to Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Strong hopelessness and Self-denial when thinking about or planning fishing, avoiding fishing and shared activities with wife
antecedent: The experience two weeks ago of failing to catch sunfish
Whenever thinking about or planning fishing
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one failure into a permanent conclusion, interpreting his own ability through predicting the future and black-and-white thinking, leading to decreased Self-efficacy
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible failure again and the accompanying disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Declining interests and daily mood; relationship tension with wife; reduced enjoyment of fishing
